items.title: Lists, Links, Backgrounds and Borders Quiz

questions.text: Which CSS property is used to specify the image to be used as a list item marker?
Which property is used to control the position of the list item marker?
What does the `line-height` property do?
distractors: It is used to set the background size for an element.
It is used to style links that have not been visited by the user.
It is used to create space to the right of list items.
questions.answer: It is used to create space between lines of text.

questions.text: Which pseudo-class is used to style links when a user hovers over them?

distractors: It is used to set the style of an element's border.
It is used to determine how background images should be repeated along the horizontal and vertical axes.
It is used to style an element that was activated by the user.
questions.answer: It is used to create a transition between multiple colors along a straight line.

questions.text: Which value for the `background-repeat` property ensures the image repeats horizontally but not vertically?
What is the purpose of the `border-radius` property?
distractors: To create shadows around the border.
To change the width of the border.
questions.answer: To round the corners of an element.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a valid value for the `background-position` property?
Which of the following `background-repeat` values can be used to repeat a background image vertically?
What does `background-position: center;` do to a background image?
distractors: It aligns the background image to the top of the element.
It repeats the background image horizontally and vertically.
It scales the background image to fill the entire element.
questions.answer: It positions the background image in the center of the element.

questions.text: Which of these is NOT a valid `border` value?
What does the `radial-gradient` function do?
distractors: It creates a background that transitions between multiple colors along a straight line.
It specifies whether the background image should scroll with the content or remain fixed in place.
It is used to style an element that was activated by the user.
questions.answer: It creates an image that radiates from a particular point and gradually transitions between multiple colors.
